assessment_summary:
0001-0164: Justified standard definitions and setup for the problem.
0165-0183: Justified statement of the generalized inversion formula (Theorem 1).
0184-0236: Justified setup of the arithmetic relationship between M(X,y) and summatory divisor functions.
0237-0311: Justified definitions of the level and statement of the main theorems (Theorems 2 and 3).
0312-0410: Justified numerical example demonstrating the inversion formula.
0411-0468: Justified proof of the inversion formula using Cramer's rule on the convolution matrix.
0469-0515: Justified lower bound for U by integrating M_chi(x, y_0) against r_lambda and shifting the contour to pick up the pole at 1+beta_0.
0516-0550: Justified upper bound for U using the entirety of g_chi(s) and bounding the integral on sigma=0.
0551-0557: Justified invocation of parameters for the Koukoulopoulos estimate.
0558: Invalid. The unconditional bound |M_chi(x,y_0)| << x e^{-c(log x)^{3/5}(...)} is false if chi has a Siegel zero, because the pole of 1/L(s,chi) at beta_0 yields a main term ~ x^{beta_0}/log y_0 which dominates the claimed error term.
0559-0593: Invalid, as these lines rely on the false bound from 0558 to conclude the proof.
